body: Vinit Teredesai (CFO) on 2025-07-23 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "In view of the current uncertain business scenario, we have decided to postpone our wage hike by a quarter." Metric: Wage-hike timing. Target: effective Q3FY26. Deadline: 2025-10-31. Specificity: precise; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-22: delivered. Evidence: 'effective October 1, 2025, we have rolled out increments to all our employees ... in line with the previous years' (Q2FY26 call).
